about: module infra's mutants: the six of the design model models/infra, planted in the code, and the driver of d02; each is judged by the module's tests and laws (scripts/examples -modules infra). The law that kills each is named in its rule.

mutants.name: ia1-no-write-ahead
mutants.from: try e.State.Put(Row[P]{ID: id, Status: Creating, Props: p, Seq: seq})
mutants.rule: The row is written before the driver's Apply, so a crash after the call leaves no orphan: memory's ApplyConverges (NoOrphan).

mutants.name: ia1-no-lock
mutants.rule: A run cannot start while another holds the lock: Lock.LockExcludes, and ApplyConverges (the second runner meets the crashed one's lock).

mutants.name: ia1-live-early
mutants.from: try e.State.Put(Row[P]{ID: id, Status: Creating, Props: p, Seq: seq})
mutants.to: try e.State.Put(Row[P]{ID: id, Status: Live, Props: p, Seq: seq})
mutants.rule: The row says live only after the driver's Apply: ApplyConverges (LiveIsTrue).

mutants.name: ia1-no-resume
mutants.rule: A row a crashed run left creating or deleting is work to do again: ApplyConverges (Converged).

mutants.name: ia1-no-sweep
mutants.rule: An object the stack no longer wants is deleted, and its row with it: ApplyConverges (Converged).

mutants.name: ia1-break-live
mutants.rule: An operator breaks only the lock of the holder named (a dead one), never a running holder's: Lock.BreakNamesTheHolder.

mutants.name: ia1-read-gives-none
mutants.from: func Read(d Dirs, id string) Option[Dir] fails infra.Failed { d.cloud.dirs.Get().Get(id) }
mutants.to: func Read(d Dirs, id string) Option[Dir] fails infra.Failed { None }
mutants.rule: After an Apply, Read gives the object: Driver.ReadAfterApply.

mutants.name: ia1-destroy-oldest-first
mutants.rule: The sweep and a destroy delete the newest object first: DestroyIsNewestFirst.

mutants.name: ia1-plan-calls-host
mutants.rule: A plan calls no host: ApplyConverges arms the fuse at the next call before each plan and finds it armed after.

mutants.name: ia4-outputs-before-the-end
mutants.rule: An apply writes its outputs only once it ended (after the sweep): memory's OutputsAfterTheApply.

mutants.name: ia4-outputs-read-as-toml
mutants.rule: std config reads the outputs in the format WriteOutputs writes: memory's OutputsRoundTrip.

mutants.name: ia3-apply-without-yes
mutants.rule: apply refuses without -yes and changes nothing: memory's CommandLineSession.

mutants.name: ia3-drift-as-noop
mutants.from: note(e.Pass, Step{Kind: e.Kind, ID: id, Change: Drifted})
mutants.rule: plan -refresh lists a drifted object as Drifted, not as no change: memory's RefreshFindsDrift.

mutants.name: ia3-plain-plan-reads
mutants.rule: a plan without -refresh reads only the rows and reports no drift: memory's RefreshFindsDrift.

mutants.name: ia3-held-exits-1
mutants.rule: a lock another holds is exit status 3, apart from a failed run's 1: memory's CommandLineSession.

mutants.name: ia3-plan-text-count
mutants.rule: the plan's text ends with its count of changes: memory's CommandLineSession.
